chunks.why: Wakes transformed into vermin; unable to rise; late for train; family knocking.
Voice unrecognizable; trapped in bed; body uncontrollable; fears losing his job.
Chief clerk arrives to investigate; Gregor crashes off bed; sister crying.
Clerk publicly threatens his job; mother declares him ill; locksmith summoned.
Opens door with jaws, bleeding; mother collapses; father clenches fists in horror.
Clerk flees in panic; mother screams and runs; father seizes stick against him.
Father drives him back with stick; stuck in doorway; injured, bleeding, slammed inside.
Wakes injured, lame, isolated; milk repellent; sister brings scraps with kindness.
Learns family has hidden savings; recalls providing for them; feels shame but relief.
Adapts to climbing walls and ceiling; sister still tends him; small physical freedoms.
Mother finally visits; wants his room kept intact; hope she still sees him as son.
Furniture stripped away; last human keepsakes lost; mother faints seeing him on picture.
Father returns transformed, uniformed and hostile; chases Gregor around the room.
Father bombards him with apples; one lodges in back, grievously wounding him.
Chronic pain from lodged apple; family exhausted; sister's care turns to neglect.
Charwoman mocks him as dung-beetle; room becomes storage dump; stops eating.
Crept out to hear sister's violin; briefly moved by beauty; longs for connection.
Lodgers give notice; sister declares he must go; family renounces him as brother.
Crawls back locked in; broken and hungry; dies peacefully at dawn thinking of family.
Dead; charwoman sweeps corpse aside; family thanks God, plans bright new life.
